_comment: Latest app builds. The apps fetch this on launch and show an 'Update available' card on Home when the running version is older. Only bump 'version' once the release is actually AVAILABLE on the store (not while it is in review) — otherwise the button leads to a store page with nothing to update.

android.notes: Fixes the app closing after the notification question; menswear options in the style quiz; outfit pictures for every body type.
